findings.issue: The decoded params offset is never named: the aligned actions length Mask(27, 5, uint32(cd[_param1 + 100]) + 31) is re-expanded 452 times, nested twice in every params[i] field access, so most lines of the action handlers pass 240 characters.
findings.rule: Bind an expression to a variable when it is used more than a few times and has no side effects (calldata is immutable within a call); here params_base = _param1 + Mask(27, 5, uint32(cd[_param1 + 100]) + 31) + 164 and each params[i] base cd[32 * idx + params_base] + params_base.
